scope: Independent numerical audit of saved screen outputs; no model execution or solver calls. Mapping audit is reused from this agent earlier in this task and rechecked by source fingerprints; not a second independent biological ID audit.

claims.claim: Both external scenarios contain exactly the original 648 unique gene IDs in raw and predicted tables.
Both external runs have only optimal finite nonnegative raw KO values; unresolved count zero.
Stored four-threshold calls match raw KO/WT strict less-than without rounding; legacy classifications agree.
The shared evaluation uses exactly the pre-result 235 mapped experimental positives; no orphan, unmapped, or unlabelled record is assigned an experimental negative label.
Current file hashes match all checked recorded model, code, medium, strain, and mapping-source identities.
Reported overall essential-count curves agree with independently recomputed raw ratios.

limitations: The mapped scenario contains 28 of 35 reference-medium exchanges; its full chemical/strain equivalence is not established. This audit confirms the recorded active medium equals the locked runtime plan, but does not repeat the separate reaction-mapping audit.
The native scenario is the saved JSON default medium, not reproduction of the paper 13C-MFA experimental conditions.

Common-positive comparison excludes unlabelled genes and nonmapped/orphan records rather than making them experimental negatives. Whole-model predicted-essential counts still include all original 648 record IDs.
No model/GPR, experimental labels, numerical thresholds, or original result tables were modified.
This audit recomputes saved-output arithmetic, not a reproduction of optimization; file identity checks do not certify a complete historical environment.
